errors.evidence: This statement is an over-generalization. While three sectors have percentage labels inside them, the green sector ('Не се анализира') does not.

The description claims that the sectors are arranged by size, but this is not true. The visual arrangement of the slices around the pie does not follow an ascending or descending order of their values.
